title: Learn-then-escalate: First dodges through Comet Walls, Zig-Zag climax, and Shield

clips.why: Teaches steering, star catching, and near-miss bonuses without tutorial clutter
Weaving between falling comets to grab another +10 star
Escalates to full-width COMET WALL! hazards
Tightens successive Comet Wall runs on last life
Big reward COMBO x2 (+20) as ZIG-ZAG! swerving comets enter
High-speed swerving comet dodge ending in explosion at 1.78 km
Showcases the Shield power-up spawn in the second-chance run
Shows BEST SCORE 60 and PLAY NOW call to action
